newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet steadily offered but NWE buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet steadily offered but NWE buyers scarce.

text.p: European jet fuel premiums were steady on Tuesday but swaps provided the main focus amid near inactive spot trade, traders said.
April IPE gas oil last traded 20 cents higher at $17.96 a tonne.
Fourth quarter 1997 swaps changed hands at $207 a tonne, with first quarter 1998 trading at $205 a tonne, traders said.

Barge premiums were between $18.50 and $17.50 over the May IPE contract. Cargo premiums in northwest Europe were talked at around $23 over the May IPE contract but only one buyer, seeking material into Hamburg, was seen in the spot-physical market.
In the Mediterranean sellers were offering at higher numbers around high fob +$10 for EC qualififed material. Non-EC material was being offered at a $7 premium to the high fob quote.
